head: madhyamā
target: sogs pas nyin mo'i tshad la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / 'jam dpal lung bstan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / grub pa'i mtha' dang byed pa'i skar rtsis kyi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / dbu ma'i rtsa'i dbugs rnams las gza'i rkang pa dang rgyu skar gyi rkang pa skye ba'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / khyim bcu gnyis kyi rnam pas sa 'khor ba'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / dbyangs 'char ba la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / sgra gcan la sogs pa sa'i stobs kyi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / rdzong 'joms pa dang bsrung ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / 'khor los sgyur bas dum bu bcu gnyis su 'khor ba'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / kla klo'i chos bcom nas sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu 'jog pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / sems can mtha' dag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi lam sbyin pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / 'jam dpal dang 'jig rten dbang phyug sngon dang phyi mar ston pa po'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ba chen po la sogs pa rigs ldan gyi mthar thug pa mi rnams mchog gi tshe'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams kyi le'u la'o/ / pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang sems can dang sngags dang srog la sogs pa 'byung ba dang sdud pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang rgya mtsho dang gling dang ri'i grangs kyi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ba chen po 'byung ba'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / shin tu phra ba'i dbugs la sogs pas nyin mo'i tshad la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / 'jam dpal lung bstan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / /

src_sentence: tataḥ sādhanāpaṭale prathamaṃ rakṣācakrādimukhaviśuddhisva' huccandrabījaraśmibhistathā- gataspharaṇasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, anuttarapūjā- pāpadeśanā- puṇyānumodanā-triśaraṇagamanātma- niryātana-bodhicittotpādana - mārgāśrayaṇa-śūnyatālambanādisvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, utpattikrameṇa maṇḍalarājāgrī (gra) karmarājāgrī (gra ) + binduyogasūkṣmayogādisādhanasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, bāhya laukikasiddhisādhanasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, yajñādivedāntaguhyatattvajñānaṣaḍaṅgayogādi- sādhanasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, dānādipuṇyasambhārasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, pratyakṣaparokṣacitta- bhāvanāsvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ || iti sādhanāpaṭale || tato jñānapaṭale prathamaṃ śarīrāsthyādi dhātuviśuddhimaṇḍalasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, kāyavākcittaṣaṭkuladevatāsvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, ādi - kādi - ṣaṇmantrakulasvabhāvatayā'va- sthitaḥ, ṣaṭtriṃśatprajñopāyatantrasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ prajñopāyakriyāyogānuviddhamahāsaṃvara- ṣaṭcakravatti sphuraṇa svabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, caturthābhiṣekaparamākṣaramahāmudrājñānasiddhisādhana- svabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, jñānamaṇḍalaspharaṇasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, bodhicittasevāsādhanasva- bhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, sarvākārajñānajñeyātmikāmahāmudrāsiddhisvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, sarva- kāyavākcittakṛtyaparīkṣāsvabhāvatayā'va sthitaḥ, caturaśītisahasra dharmaṃ skandhadeśanā- bhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, buddhakṣetre vajrādhiṣṭhānasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, nānādhimuktisattvāśayavaśena dharmadeśanāsvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, rasarasāyanādiśarīra siddhisādhanasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, paramākṣarasukhena sarvasattvārthaka raṇasvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ, dharmasaṃgrahagaṇitasaṃjñāsaṃgrahasvabhāva- tayā'vasthitaḥ, pañcākṣara-ṣaḍakṣara-mahāśūnya-binduśūnya-stutisvabhāvatayā'vasthitaḥ || iti jñānapaṭale || ṅa

head: tasmāt
target: de'i phyir 'di'i zhabs la skyabs su song la rgyud kyi rgyal po dang po'i sangs rgyas la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i lam dbang bskur bar gsol ba thob cig ces so/ / de nas rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyi tshig de dang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong rnams rab tu sad de tshig 'di smras pa/ de'i phyir 'di'i zhabs la skyabs su song la rgyud kyi rgyal po dang po'i sangs rgyas la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i lam dbang bskur bar gsol ba thob cig ces so/ / de nas rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyi tshig de dang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong rnams rab tu sad de tshig 'di smras pa/

bo: 'dir sngon gyi dus na rig byed dang glu dang grub pa'i mtha' dang sngon gyi rabs kyi chos rnams

target: 'jig rten pa'i 'dod pa dang po rigs pas rnam par dpyad de 'dir rang rang gi grub pa'i mtha'i bsam pa'i dbang gis rtsis kyi tha snyad med cing 'dod pa gcig tu mi 'gyur ro/ / de nyid kyi phyir rnam par dpyad par bya ste/ 'dir 'go la la nyi ma las myur ba dang dal bar 'gro ba'i gza' gang yin pa de dag ci steng nas steng dang 'og nas 'og tu gnas sam/ 'jig rten pa'i 'dod pa dang po rigs pas rnam par dpyad de 'dir rang rang gi grub pa'i mtha'i bsam pa'i dbang gis rtsis kyi tha snyad med cing 'dod pa gcig tu mi 'gyur ro/ / de nyid kyi phyir rnam par dpyad par bya ste/ 'dir 'go la la nyi ma las myur ba dang dal bar 'gro ba'i gza' gang yin pa de dag ci steng nas steng dang 'og nas 'og tu gnas sam/
src_sentence: laukikamataṃ prathamaṃ yuktyā vicāryate- atra gaṇitavyavahāro nāsti; svasvasiddhāntābhiprāyavaśāditi ekamataṃ na bhavati, tasmādevaṃ vicāryate - iha gole ye grahāḥ sūryācchīghramandagāminaste kimuparyu - paryadho'dhaḥ sthitāḥ, atha vāmabhāgato dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ sthitā iti ?

src_sentence: iha saṃsāre yaḥ cyutikṣaṇaḥ sattvānāmutpati karoti rajaḥ śukrasaṃyuktam ālaya vijñānadharmī garbhe tato garbhāse prasavanasamayaṃ karoti bālakaumārādi rūpaṃ karoti śarīrasya sṛṣṭisa hāra sa evya cyutikṣaṇo loke svargamartyapātāle punarapi kurute kālacakro na sūryaḥ sūryo rajaḥ candraḥ śukram ālayavijñānena vinā kālacakreṇa vinā na karotītyarthaḥ iha kasmānna karoti rajaḥ śukradharmī sūryacandra iti iha sarvatrāgnisūrya somātmakaṃ jagaditi prasiddhaṃ vākyamityucyate iha yataścandrā dityādidevān grasati sa bhagavān rātribhāge sabhūtāniti iha saṃsāre rātribhāgaścandraḥ sṛṣṭiḥ divābhāgaḥ sūryaḥ saṃhārastān atra rātribhāge utpattikāle sa ālayavijñānalakṣaṇo ' kṣaṇalakṣaṇa- kālacakraniyamamahoddeśaḥ mātṛgarbhe candraḥ śukram ādityo rajaḥ; ādiśabdena viṇmūtrasambhūtāni pṛthivyaptejovāyvā- kāśadhātusahitān grasati rajaḥ śukrādhārasthitaḥ kāyavākcittaniṣpādanārtham, candraḥ śukramīśvaraḥ, rajaḥ sūryaḥ sadāśiva:, majjā rudraḥ, mūtraṃ viṣṇuḥ, brahmā viḍiti |

src_sentence: iha saṃsāre yaḥ cyutikṣaṇaḥ sattvānāmutpati karoti rajaḥ śukrasaṃyuktam ālaya vijñānadharmī garbhe tato garbhāse prasavanasamayaṃ karoti bālakaumārādi rūpaṃ karoti śarīrasya sṛṣṭisa hāra sa evya cyutikṣaṇo loke svargamartyapātāle punarapi kurute kālacakro na sūryaḥ sūryo rajaḥ candraḥ śukram ālayavijñānena vinā kālacakreṇa vinā na karotītyarthaḥ iha kasmānna karoti rajaḥ śukradharmī sūryacandra iti iha sarvatrāgnisūrya somātmakaṃ jagaditi prasiddhaṃ vākyamityucyate iha yataścandrā dityādidevān grasati sa bhagavān rātribhāge sabhūtāniti iha saṃsāre rātribhāgaścandraḥ sṛṣṭiḥ divābhāgaḥ sūryaḥ saṃhārastān atra rātribhāge utpattikāle sa ālayavijñānalakṣaṇo ' kṣaṇalakṣaṇa- kālacakraniyamamahoddeśaḥ mātṛgarbhe candraḥ śukram ādityo rajaḥ; ādiśabdena viṇmūtrasambhūtāni pṛthivyaptejovāyvā- kāśadhātusahitān grasati rajaḥ śukrādhārasthitaḥ kāyavākcittaniṣpādanārtham, candraḥ śukramīśvaraḥ, rajaḥ sūryaḥ sadāśiva:, majjā rudraḥ, mūtraṃ viṣṇuḥ, brahmā viḍiti |
